Biography as supplied.

David is a master's student working on evolutionary dynamics in algorithmic trading systems. His thesis explores how machine learning algorithms compete and adapt in financial markets, drawing parallels with biological evolution.

Areas of expertise

Algorithmic Trading · Machine Learning · Market Analysis

Education as supplied

  • BS in Computer Science, Carnegie Mellon University

Research interests

  • Machine learning in finance
  • Evolutionary algorithms
  • High-frequency trading dynamics
  • Market microstructure
